name: Jackfruit
siboNotes: Start with small portions as jackfruit contains excess fructose and fructans that can trigger SIBO symptoms. Young jackfruit may be better tolerated than very ripe fruit.
preparationTips: Choose less ripe jackfruit for potentially lower FODMAP content
Pair with glucose-rich foods to help balance fructose absorption
Remove seeds and fibrous core before eating
Canned young jackfruit in brine is often better tolerated than fresh ripe fruit
